name: Speak with Anastasia
summary: In the Undercity, Cain Firesong sends a promising Forsaken mage to Anastasia Hartwell. Her summons calls you to the Magic Quarter for work among the Forsaken magi, with investigations in Tirisfal Glades ahead.

sections.title: A Call to the Magic Quarter
sections.body: Cain Firesong trains young Forsaken mages in Brill, then sends those with promise to the Undercity. In its Magic Quarter, the Forsaken magi pursue arcane study and plan defenses across Lordaeron. Cain judges which students are ready to serve more experienced practitioners. Those who show real talent are sent to Anastasia Hartwell, who needs capable hands in the field.

sections.title: Anastasia Hartwell's Ambition
sections.body: Anastasia Hartwell is one of the Undercity's prominent mage instructors. She puts promising students to work for the Forsaken's practical and territorial interests instead of leaving them to study incantations in safety. Answering her call marks a step into service for the Forsaken's mages and their pragmatic magical work in the years after the Scourge.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Anastasia Hartwell?
faq.answer: Cain Firesong, your Forsaken mage trainer in Brill, sends you to Anastasia Hartwell when he judges your arcane talent ready for harder work in the Undercity.

faq.q: Where can Anastasia Hartwell be found?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell is in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, where she instructs Forsaken practitioners of the arcane arts.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this summons?
faq.answer: Anastasia seeks a capable caster for practical work beyond the city walls, beginning with field assignments in Tirisfal Glades, such as investigating the Balnir Farmstead.

faq.q: What quest follows Speak with Anastasia?
aliases: next quest after speak with anastasia
faq.answer: After you report to Anastasia, she sends you to The Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades to gather snapdragons from its garden.

faq.q: Is this quest limited to certain classes?
aliases: is this a mage only quest
who can do speak with anastasia
faq.answer: Yes. This summons is for Forsaken mages, marking a step in their class training as they reach early competence around circle ten.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken mages maintain their own quarters in Undercity?
faq.answer: The Magic Quarter gives Forsaken arcanists, warlocks, and researchers a place to study and cast apart from the physical quarters. There, they continue traditions from before the Third War beneath Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a mage, you move from basic arcane training into active service for the mages of the Undercity.
As a Forsaken arcanist, you can put Lordaeron's intellectual past to work against the perils facing it now.
